policy: ArthaSaar hosts collected snapshots on GitHub Pages. Browser refresh re-reads these files; it does not make exchange data live. Upstream GitHub Actions collectors must run and update the JSON for market data to change.

feeds.label: Equity EOD / Screener
feeds.note: Latest EOD close is overlaid from NSE security bhav data when available; historical technicals use Yahoo/yfinance with fallback.

feeds.label: Index snapshot
feeds.note: Current/EOD snapshot, not a 139-index intraday stream.

feeds.label: FII/FPI + DII
feeds.note: NSE marks the report as provisional; figures can be revised.

feeds.label: Security delivery %
feeds.note: Derived directly from NSE security bhav/deliverable data.

feeds.label: F&O Bhavcopy / PCR
feeds.note: EOD derivatives data; not a live option-chain socket.

feeds.label: Daily chart history
feeds.note: Convenient free source with rate-limit/availability risk; not an NSE primary feed.

feeds.label: Mutual fund NAV
feeds.coverage: All schemes available from AMFI NAV download
feeds.note: AMFI publishes NAVs daily; NAV is end-of-day, not intraday.

feeds.label: Market news / news volume
feeds.note: Headline aggregation; ranking/sentiment is indicative and rule-based.

feeds.label: Crypto market
feeds.note: Free Demo plan exists but has usage limits and attribution requirements; keep collector-side caching low-volume.

feeds.label: Derived analytics
feeds.note: These are calculations/models, not exchange-provided facts.

feeds.label: All-index daily history
feeds.note: Daily all-index close archive from NSE public ind_close_all CSV.

feeds.label: Research Radar — 44 free features
feeds.note: Corporate filings, 52W, breadth history, index membership/weight changes, macro, bulk/block, results, sector rotation, descriptive regime and data resilience. NSE is primary; Yahoo remains historical backup.

feeds.label: Research Radar alert feed
feeds.coverage: Breakout, volume, delivery, F&O, index and filing alerts
feeds.note: Descriptive alerts generated from committed public snapshots; not recommendations.

feeds.label: Research Lab history + event outcomes
feeds.coverage: Historical signal outcomes, breadth replay and research snapshots
feeds.note: Outcome statistics use only prices after each stored signal date. General backtests may contain survivorship bias; NIFTY 50-aware companion statistics use stored membership history.
